item.title: What platform has the best AI CMO?
item.summary: I've seen heycatch and okara, maybe a few others like it... seems like they plug into reddit api and provide ai ugc tools. Does anyone have any success using tools like these? I wouldn't imagine much, but I wanted to get a temperature check. What's working, whats not? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49443800 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
